items.title: Apple's foldable iPhone is 'not new': AT&T CEO
items.summary: AT&T (T) CEO John Stankey joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi at the Goldman Sachs Tech Conference to discuss Apple's iPhone Duo.

items.summary: Apple put its AI strategy on full display during its iPhone Duo event.

items.title: Apple launches iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
items.summary: Apple debuted its iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.

items.title: How John Ternus understood the assignment in the Apple launch event opener
items.summary: Newly minted Apple (AAPL) CEO John Ternus took the spotlight in the cinematic opener at the company's latest launch event, his predecessor Tim Cook handing the torch off in front of the audience. Creative Strategies CEO and principal analyst Ben Bajarin comes on Market Domination to talk about Ternus' presentation and how he represented Apple's core ideals.

items.title: Apple named its new foldable iPhone the Duo. Duolingo noticed.
items.summary: The language-learning app Duolingo had fun reacting to Apple's new foldable iPhone product reveal.

items.title: Apple unveils upgraded Siri AI
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) introduced the latest update to Siri, Siri AI, during its annual fall event. The upgraded version of the virtual assistant will be integrated into emails, texts, and the iPhone's camera.

items.title: Watch Tim Cook's cinematic introduction of John Ternus during Apple event
items.summary: Tim Cook gave Apple's (AAPL) CEO John Ternus a cinematic introduction during the company's annual event. It is the first event Ternus will be presenting at as head of the company.
